production_route.decision: Remain production-facing until a future cutover PR satisfies every G-6 gate.

godot_review_route.decision: Remain a review and migration validation route; do not replace the Worker in G-6.

decision_matrix.option: Keep the JavaScript Worker as production route
decision_matrix.reason: The Worker is still the complete gameplay, save, and deployment reference. Godot has visual/runtime foundation plus migration architecture, but not gameplay parity implementation.
decision_matrix.risk: Future Godot work can drift if parity fixtures are skipped.
decision_matrix.guardrail: G-5.1 through G-5.9 must create contracts, save compatibility, service migration, visual proof, and parity evidence before replacement is reconsidered.

decision_matrix.option: Continue Godot as an itch.io browser-review route
decision_matrix.reason: The current Godot web review pipeline exists and does not disturb production hosting.
decision_matrix.risk: Manual itch upload can lag behind main.
decision_matrix.guardrail: Each review build must list source commit, validation results, screenshots, and upload status.

decision_matrix.option: Use a separate Cloudflare Pages preview for Godot
decision_matrix.reason: Cloudflare Pages is the preferred static preview target when export size and upload constraints are solved.
decision_matrix.risk: The Godot wasm artifact has exceeded Pages Direct Upload single-file limits in prior evidence.
decision_matrix.guardrail: Pages may be used only as a separate preview project, never by reusing the production Worker route.

decision_matrix.option: Replace the production Worker route with Godot
decision_matrix.reason: G-5 migration implementation and parity evidence do not exist yet.
decision_matrix.risk: Replacing now would drop quests, combat, inventory, save/load, persistence, economy, and player trust.
decision_matrix.guardrail: Only a future cutover PR may change root deployment after every G-6 QA gate passes.

decision_matrix.option: Keep Worker as ingress/API while Godot becomes the client
decision_matrix.reason: This shape best matches the future server-authoritative Durable Object/D1 direction, but requires migrated Godot domain services and save compatibility.
decision_matrix.risk: Premature hybrid routing can split canonical state across client and Worker.
decision_matrix.guardrail: Hybrid work must begin only after SaveService, EntityRegistry, and MigrationQA fixtures pass.

hard_cutover_preconditions: All G-5 migration sequence rows from G-5.1 through G-5.9 are implemented or explicitly superseded with equivalent evidence.
Worker golden fixtures exist for save payloads, movement, quest states, inventory/equipment, combat outcomes, persistent objects, UI feedback, and deployment smoke behavior.
Godot SaveService can import, repair, preserve, and export Worker save schema v2 without losing player progress.
Godot gameplay services own the migrated systems; sprites, HUD, animation, and scene scripts do not own canonical mutations.
Side-by-side Worker/Godot parity reports pass for core loop, quests, combat, inventory, economy, dungeon persistence, and save/load.
Normal-play Godot screenshots pass the atelier runtime asset consistency gate with no visible placeholder/debug assets.
Remote checks pass on the cutover PR, including route-protection validation proving rollback is still possible.
A rollback rehearsal demonstrates how to restore the JavaScript Worker route and preserve or downgrade saves safely.
Release notes clearly separate known caveats from blockers.

qa_gates.name: Branch and remote preflight
qa_gates.required_evidence: Branch starts from latest origin/main, worktree clean, no conflicting open PRs, remote auth healthy.

qa_gates.name: Production route protection
qa_gates.required_evidence: Root wrangler.toml still points at wayfarer_v7_github_ready/worker/src/index.js unless the PR is the explicit final cutover PR.

qa_gates.name: G-5 parity evidence
qa_gates.required_evidence: G-5.1 through G-5.9 implementation reports, validators, screenshots where player-facing, and council verdicts.

qa_gates.name: Save compatibility round trip
qa_gates.required_evidence: Worker schema v2 fixtures import, repair, preserve unknown fields where possible, export, and reload without progress loss.

qa_gates.name: Godot web export served validation
qa_gates.required_evidence: Fresh Godot export launches in a browser-like served environment, not only from local editor state.

qa_gates.name: Runtime visual QA
qa_gates.required_evidence: No-HUD/no-debug screenshots prove player, NPCs, markers, props, streets, harbor, and UI meet the active visual bar.

qa_gates.name: Performance and browser matrix
qa_gates.required_evidence: Desktop browser smoke coverage, input latency, load time, memory, crash-free runtime, and fallback notes.

qa_gates.name: Rollback rehearsal
qa_gates.required_evidence: Documented restore path for Worker route, saved data compatibility, and deployment rollback timing.

qa_gates.name: Release authority
qa_gates.required_evidence: Agent Council final authority report for the cutover PR and explicit merge/cutover authorization.

cutover_runbook.name: Freeze production route
cutover_runbook.action: Confirm the current Worker deployment and source commit before any route edit.

cutover_runbook.name: Build Godot candidate
cutover_runbook.action: Export Godot Web from the validated commit and serve it from the preview route.

cutover_runbook.name: Run parity and save gates
cutover_runbook.action: Run Worker/Godot parity fixtures, save round trips, vertical slice validation, runtime asset consistency validation, and browser smoke checks.

cutover_runbook.name: Inspect player-facing proof
cutover_runbook.action: Capture and inspect screenshots for normal play, no-HUD, UI feedback, combat/quest/inventory surfaces, and debug-disabled state.

cutover_runbook.name: Prepare explicit cutover PR
cutover_runbook.action: Only the final cutover PR may edit production routing files. The PR must include rollback commands and all QA evidence.

cutover_runbook.name: Verify remote checks
cutover_runbook.action: Wait for GitHub checks and hosted smoke results before merging.

cutover_runbook.name: Post-cutover monitor
cutover_runbook.action: Confirm served gameplay, save/load, first quest, combat, inventory, and rollback readiness after merge/deploy.

rollback_runbook.name: Restore Worker routing
rollback_runbook.action: Revert root deployment routing to wayfarer_v7_github_ready/worker/src/index.js and ./wayfarer_v7_github_ready/worker/assets.

rollback_runbook.name: Preserve saves
rollback_runbook.action: Keep migrated save backups and, if needed, export a Worker-readable schema v2 payload before downgrading the route.

rollback_runbook.name: Redeploy Worker
rollback_runbook.action: Deploy the known-good Worker commit and verify production URL behavior.

rollback_runbook.name: Capture rollback evidence
rollback_runbook.action: Record production smoke results, save behavior, and any player-facing caveats in the rollback report.

known_caveats_not_blockers_for_g6: G-6 defines cutover safety but does not implement G-5.1 through G-5.9 migration systems.
Godot remains a browser-review route until parity implementation and cutover proof exist.
Cloudflare Pages remains a separate preview option and not the production replacement route.
blockers_to_actual_cutover: G-5 migration implementation sequence is not complete.
Godot save compatibility bridge is not implemented.
Worker/Godot parity fixture suite is not implemented.
Rollback rehearsal has not been executed against an actual cutover candidate.
